sections.title: Independent Study
sections.description: MTR students may perform an independent study for credit based on meeting specific educational requirements. All independent study courses require a designated supervisor and prior approval from at least one member of the MTR curriculum committee who will serve as course director. All members of the curriculum committee are eligible to be course directors. An independent study course can be performed in a broad ranger of activities and settings, as long as the mission and content of the class are consistent with the overarching goals of the MTR program and similar material is not available as an existing class. Independent study plans must hae a learning objective, plan of study and methods of assessment. These elements should be drafted by the student and must be approved by both the MTR designated course director and content specific independent study mentor at least 6 weeks prior to the planned start date. Independent study plans are expected to consist of approximately 10 hours per week of activities for 10 weeks.
